It is a good choice for anyone who likes florals but wants something with a little more structure.

Fumeri Victorious is a fresh eau de parfum for men, opening with bergamot, grapefruit and a marine accord. Aromatic spices, lavender and cedarwood shape the heart, and amber, musk and vetiver give it a clean, earthy base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Marine Accord, Grapefruit
  • Heart notes: Aromatic Spices, Lavender, Cedarwood
  • Base notes: Amber, Musk, Vetiver

How it wears

The citrus and sea notes make the opening bright and energising, and the lavender gives it a classic aromatic feel that many men will recognise from barbershop-style scents. Cedar and vetiver then add a dry, woody backbone, with amber softening the edges. It is a natural fit for warm weather, office days, the gym bag or a weekend away, and it stays smart enough for an evening in summer. Because it is an eau de parfum, the fresh notes come with a little more body than an eau de toilette.

Fumeri Wild is a unisex eau de parfum with a spiced, smoky character. Aromatic spices and bergamot give it an energetic start, then smoky woods and an amber accord take over, and vanilla, musk and vetiver finish it with an earthy warmth.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Aromatic Spices, Bergamot
  • Heart notes: Smoky Woods, Amber Accord
  • Base notes: Vanilla, Musk, Vetiver

How it wears

Wild feels raw at first, with the spices and smoke out front, yet the vanilla and musk smooth it into something refined as it settles. Vetiver keeps the base dry and grounded so the sweetness never takes over. It suits cold weather, nights out and occasions where you want a scent with real personality, and both men and women can wear it. On a summer day, keep it for the evening.

Fun & Basics Be Fun Man is an eau de toilette for men with a warm, gourmand heart of roasted coffee beans, chocolate and hazelnuts. Bergamot and myrtle give it a fresh, herbal opening, and leather and cedarwood bring a dry, woody base.

Fragrance notes

  • Top notes: Bergamot, Myrtle
  • Heart notes: Roasted Coffee Beans, Chocolate, Hazelnuts
  • Base notes: Leather, Cedarwood

How it wears

The opening is green and citrusy, but the coffee, chocolate and nut notes soon give it a toasty, comforting feel. Leather and cedar stop the sweetness from becoming sugary and keep a masculine edge. It works well as an easy everyday scent in autumn and winter, for casual evenings, or as a gift for someone who likes the smell of a coffee shop. As an eau de toilette it is lighter in concentration than an eau de parfum, which makes it relaxed enough for daytime.
